notes.title: Important: Lionheart Final Sale!
notes.notes:
Lionheart is now -90% off in the Steam Lunar Sale. If you have it wishlisted, we strongly recommend taking the opportunity to add it to your library now, because we will be [b]discontinuing Lionheart in the store after February 11[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25960324/0808be654e7d2848c762e3d767b79736bb6c4bf3.png[/img]

The game will remain permanently playable in your library afterwards.

We've enjoyed our time with the game, and hope all the new players will enjoy the adventure too!

notes.title: Lionheart Is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25960324/06db1f921b95ae34cbb7f8cb6b74102418199349.png[/img]
We're excited to announce that Lionheart has just been released on Steam! 

Join Leon Lionheart and his crew on a 50-100 hour adventure and uncover the secrets of the Libra Corridor!

This fantastic RPG by developer Shiisanmei features a cast of 10+ playable characters with original Japanese voice acting, and 3 difficulty settings to adjust your experience with.

Happy adventuring!

notes.title: The Adventure Begins July 31!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25960324/88d368121f138a2e033c7cfe12993995f8a1fb3c.jpg[/img]We're happy to announce that the adventure will commence on July 31st! 

Join Leon Lionheart and his party as they explore the forbidden depths of a magical labyrinth and meet new allies in this beautifully illustrated RPG that is voiced in Japanese and has an estimated playtime of 50-100 hours!

The English version features new monster art and an improved UI, as well as 3 difficulty modes that can be changed at any time. 

[h1]Game Features[/h1]
[list][*]Over 10 playable characters
[*]More than 100 different monster types
[*]3 difficulty options: Casual, Normal and Heroic
[*]Monster art and user interface upgraded for Steam version[/list]
